candidates.change_summary: Replace the require condition to always revert, so the function never increments depositsCount.
Change the require condition to the negation of the original, so it always passes except when depositCount is zero.
Delete the require statement, so depositsCount is incremented unconditionally.
Replace the increment with a decrement, so depositsCount decreases on receive.
Delete the entire function body, so receive() does nothing.
Swap the order of the require and increment statements to increment first, then check a stale condition.
Replace the body of withdrawAll with an empty function (no withdrawal).
Replace the call to withdraw(address(this).balance) with a zero withdrawal.
Delete the onlyOwner modifier, allowing anyone to call withdrawAll.
Change the require condition to always fail, so onlyOwner always reverts.
Change the require condition to always succeed, making onlyOwner a no-op.
Replace `transfer(_value)` with `transfer(0)` so that no ether is sent, making the withdraw balance unchanged.
Delete the body of the function, leaving it empty so no transfer occurs.
Replace _target.call with _target.transfer to throw on failure and change call behavior.
Replace _target.call with _target.send to limit gas and return false on failure.
Replace require(msg.sender == owner) with require(msg.sender != owner) to invert the modifier.
